verdict.rationale: Stripe documents no-code Payment Links you can share immediately and a prebuilt hosted Checkout page that accepts cards and many other payment methods, plus bank-account payout setup. A hands-on community report says the user was 'up and running and accepting recurring payments in less than an hour.' Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the account activation/verification timeline from signup to live payments, and recent independent corroboration. One founder also reports being denied an account because of an offshore-entity/non-US-bank setup, so eligibility is not universal.
